title: Changelog Ledger
description: Per-version changelog ledger. One curated entry per Gate-3 merge; entries are marked released by release.yml on a successful real release.

id.description: Unique slug. Must not collide with any existing entry.

version.description: mod_version this merge ships as (computed at Gate 3). Descriptive only; release inclusion is governed by 'released'.

tags.description: Player-facing classification the Versions page filters by. The type-derived tag (feat→feature, fix→fix, content→content, perf→performance, chore/ci/refactor/docs/test→internal) is always present, so the list is never empty; topical tags are added on top.

major.description: Optional major release. A major entry renders first in the release notes (title as a heading, photo, then its description — or, without one, the summary plus highlights under 'Other significant updates'), above the tag line and outside the per-version groups, so it opens the GitHub/Modrinth/CurseForge body and the Discord post. The web update page shows it as the headline card.

description.description: Major release only: markdown description rendered under the heading, replacing summary + highlights.

image.description: Major release only: https:// URL of the release photo.

video.description: Major release only: https:// URL of an MP4 clip with sound (at most 30 s). The relay builds the update's Facebook, Instagram (feed and story) and TikTok videos from it, keeping its sound, instead of looping the picture.

videos.description: Major release only: a clip per social format, each recorded for that post's visible area (feed: Facebook and Instagram, 1080x994 above the title band; story: 1080x1494; tiktok: 1080x894). A format without one uses video.

mentions.description: Major release only: per-platform handles for links in the description. Key: a link's text as written in the description (any case). Value: the handle that link shows as in the Instagram and TikTok captions, which can't hold links. Facebook keeps the text and the link.

video_cover.description: Major release only, with video: the second of the clip whose frame is the posts' cover. Without it the relay takes 0.5 s in.

milestone.description: Major release only: a moment rather than an update (a store launch, an approval). The web update page labels its card 'Milestone' instead of 'Major release'.

notable.description: Major release only: the middle tier between major and minor. It still leads the release notes and posts to #highlights, but the web update page shows a smaller, milestone-sized 'Notable update' card. Never together with milestone.

addresses.description: Optional player-reported issues this entry fixes or improves. The in-game bug-report response uses it to tell a player reporting that issue that a newer release addresses it.

released.description: False until shipped. Flipped true by release.yml on a successful real release.

released_in.description: Release tag the entry shipped in, e.g. v0.292.0. Null while unreleased.

released_at.description: UTC timestamp the entry was marked released. Null while unreleased.
